title: Demistifying Data and Simulator Assumptions in Supervised Causal Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2609.37446v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Supervised causal discovery learns to infer causal structure for a new dataset from training datasets paired with structural labels. These training pairs are typically simulated, making the simulator both a source of supervision and a carrier of assumptions about causal graphs, mechanisms, and noise. Understanding the resulting predictions therefore requires examining how these assumptions supplement the information available in observational data, which may be compatible with multiple causal graphs. This paper examines that relationship across representative methods available through June 2026. We organize these methods by prediction target, prediction granularity, encoder, structural decoder, and training regime to relate what each method predicts to how it uses data and simulator-based supervision. translated_title: 揭秘监督式因果发现中的数据与模拟器假设
translated_abstract: 监督式因果发现通过从带有结构标签的训练数据集中学习，来为新数据集推断因果结构。这些训练数据对通常由模拟生成，这使得模拟器既是监督信息的来源，也是关于因果图、因果机制和噪声等假设的载体。因此，要理解模型产生的预测，就需要考察这些假设如何补充观测数据中可获得的信息，而观测数据本身可能与多个因果图相容。本文考察了截至2026年6月可得的一系列代表性方法中这种关系。我们按照预测目标、预测粒度、编码器、结构解码器和训练方式来组织这些方法，从而将每种方法所预测的内容与其如何使用数据和基于模拟器的监督联系起来。利用这一框架，我们区分了两个问题：即在所假设的模型类下该目标是否可识别，以及训练后的模型……
tldr: 本文系统梳理了截至2026年6月的监督式因果发现方法，揭示模拟器假设如何补充观测数据信息，并区分了“目标在假设模型类下是否可识别”与“训练模型能否学到该目标”这两个关键问题。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically organizes supervised causal discovery methods by prediction target, granularity, encoder, structural decoder, and training regime, clarifying how simulator assumptions supplement observational data and distinguishing identifiability under the assumed model class from what trained models actually learn.
